The experience taught Amy more than any book could. Little by little, things began to change. Mia always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Best of all, the light rail crosses the river twice.

Mia and Amy are preparing a report about the train station. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. We sailed across the Mediterranean Sea last July.
People around Amy often share different ideas about the train station. Amy's dream job is to be a nurse. Amy believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, a bivvy bag sheds the worst rain.

The ticket office has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Amy has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. Best of all, the tour guide explained the temple's history.
The train station looked quieter than usual that evening. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Amy wrote down every idea in a small notebook.
